title: Build FR-40 arm material: brain records, packets and static standards
body:
FR-40 slice 2 of 4 (parent t-y46gy0w). Arm material: brain records, packet builder (arm B) and static standards (arm S).
What: the minimal ADR 0002 record shape (id, type, text, recorded_at, valid_from, valid_to, source) as reviewed JSON files, built from sources dated before the task base (ADRs, docs/program, decisions log, closed task bodies); a deterministic packet builder (D32: a Product module outside core under its own command, shadow packets under `.krn/`, never injected outside FR-40 arms) that selects records by task text with recorded_at ≤ base date and a fixed token budget; arm S material: the same token budget of static AGENTS.md/workflow standards, identical for every task.
Leak guard: a packet must not contain the scorer's literal expected answer beyond the convention text itself; test it.
Acceptance: `krn` command builds a packet for a task id and prints its record ids, as-of date and token count; budget equality between B and S is checked by a test; packets for all slice-1 tasks build deterministically (same sha256 twice).
